sentences.text: Shri Pushpendra Dubey - Advocate for the applicant.
Shri S.M. Patel - Panel Lawyer for the respondent/State.

Order 
This is the first application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 482 of Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, for grant of anticipatory bail.

2. The applicant is apprehending his arrest in relation to Crime No.251/2023 registered at Police Station- Ratibarh, District- Bhopal (M.P.), for the offence punishable under Sections 376 and 506 of the IPC.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that although on the basis of the complaint made by the prosecutrix the offence registered against the present applicant, but according to him it is false allegation.
Prosecutrix is involved in such type of cases and habitual for making false complaint against the person to get them implicated and to extract money.

According to the present applicant,
it is nothing but a honey trap and he has filed several documents indicating that the prosecutrix is some how involved in other incident reported by the victim to the Police about such type of false registration of the cases.

He has also submitted that the report has not been made immediately after the incident, but it has been made on the next day and according to the applicant a photographs have also been taken at the time when prosecutrix was taking money from the applicant so as to settle NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:5881 2 MCRC-3199-2025 the issue.

He submits later on that an affidavit has been filed by the prosecutrix by saying that the false report made to the Amit Singh Parihar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 6 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/92858433/
1 Police by her because of some dispute between the applicant and the prosecutrix.

sentences.text: Upon these grounds, it is prayed that the applicant be granted the benefit of anticipatory bail.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State opposes the bail application read over the case diary and also the FSL report saying that it is positive.

5. However, looking to the delay in lodging the FIR and physical examination of the prosecutrix,
prima facie appears that the FSL report is not proper.
6.

Considering the other submissions of learned counsel for the parties and on perusal of case-diary,
I am inclined to grant interim protection to the applicant, therefore, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, the anticipatory bail application is allowed.

7. It is directed that in the event of arrest, the applicant be released on bail upon his furnishing a bail bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Station House Officer/Arresting Officer of the Police Station concerned.
8. The applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 482(2) of the Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.

(SANJAY DWIVEDI) JUDGE Vin**
